agent_types.EnvironmentAgent: Monitors and updates the state of the environment, providing essential data to other agents for decision-making.
agent_types.DecisionAgent: Processes information from the EnvironmentAgent and other agents to make high-level decisions that guide system actions.
agent_types.CommunicationAgent: Facilitates information exchange between agents, ensuring seamless interaction and effective coordination.
agent_types.ExecutionAgent: Carries out tasks and actions determined by the DecisionAgent, interacting directly with the environment as needed.
agent_types.LearningAgent: Adaptively improves system performance by analyzing past actions and outcomes, evolving strategies over time.
